request.prompt: Create exactly one isolated full-body image of Miranda Lawson in her canonical BLACK AND GOLD LOYALTY OUTFIT from Mass Effect 2, faithfully matching the four supplied references. Reference 1 is the controlling complete three-quarter native model view; reproduce its original T-pose, the same camera angle facing slightly toward image left, extended arms, gloved hands and complete boots. Reference 2 is the full frontal corroboration of the exact same outfit, and reference 3 is the back view for construction consistency only, not a second figure. Reference 4 is a cropped in-game screenshot used ONLY to corroborate Miranda's face, blue eyes, black side-parted shoulder-length hair, neckline, insignia and upper-outfit materials. Do not include any other characters, gun or environment from that screenshot. Preserve her native adult proportions, recognizable face, exact black full-length fitted suit, thin gold piping following the shoulder seams and asymmetrical front closure, standing collar with the small rectangular center neck connection, narrow exposed upper-chest opening, white upper-chest insignia, white/gold emblem on her left chest, gold patterned side-waist panels, black diagonal layered hip belt and exact buckle construction, black thigh panels outlined with gold, inset knee guards, fitted black lower legs, full black closed boots, long black sleeves and full gloves. Do not redesign or replace this with her white standard outfit, Alternate Appearance Pack 2 armor, romance outfit or a modded recolor. Do not add weapons, armor plates, straps, jewelry, exposed abdomen, decorative panels or new symbols. Use the intact native reference textures and conservative in-game surface shading; no fashion reinterpretation, no extra gloss, no exaggerated anatomy. Keep the native T-pose and all fingers visible, with the face looking in the reference direction and normal blue eyes as confirmed in reference 4, rather than the dark unlit eyes of the temporary model render. Show the ENTIRE single subject from top of hair to bottom of both complete soles, with at least 10 percent empty margin on every side and no cropped fingertips. Real transparent alpha background. Remove the gray inspection background and any floor, cast shadow, pedestal, halo, UI, labels or borders. One complete figure in one three-quarter view, no collage or multiple poses. This is a static costume prototype, not a certification of engine materials or animation.
